_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of Microsoft's Azure Arc onboarding role from the azure.azcollection Ansible collection. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: azure.azcollection azure_arc role (Azure Arc onboarding with Ansible)
release: v4.2.0 (tag v4.2.0 points at this commit; azure.azcollection 4.2.0 on Ansible Galaxy holds byte-identical role files)
files_last_changed: 2026-08-13 (commit 7ecaba6c36c49d3f86f711bad767b032bd1b56b0, which changed tasks/main.yml; the signal tasks came on 2026-07-13 in dba5f53e2dbda6f7619501cf25a772bd0e9142c7)
license: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later (LICENSE, copied from the repository root; the role's meta/main.yml says GPL-3.0-or-later). The collection's Galaxy MANIFEST.json says GPL-2.0-or-later; the repository's LICENSE file is GPLv3.
not_copied: Everything else in ansible-collections/azure: the collection's modules (azure_rm_accesstoken_info and azure_rm_resourcegroup_info, which the role calls, are installed with the collection from requirements.yml), plugins, tests, CHANGELOG.md, galaxy.yml, requirements.txt and CI files.
